import { toDisplayString as _toDisplayString, createElementVNode as _createElementVNode, openBlock as _openBlock, createElementBlock as _createElementBlock, Fragment as _Fragment, renderList as _renderList } from "vue"

export function render(_ctx, _cache) {
  return (_openBlock(), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, [
    _createElementVNode("table", { class: "grid" }, [
      _createElementVNode("tr", null, [
        _createElementVNode("th", null, "Name")
      ]),
      (_openBlock(true), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, _renderList(_ctx.rows, (row) => {
        return (_openBlock(), _createElementBlock("tr", { key: row.id }, [
          _createElementVNode("td", null, _toDisplayString(row.name), 1 /* TEXT */)
        ]))
      }), 128 /* KEYED_FRAGMENT */)),
      (_openBlock(true), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, _renderList(_ctx.extra, (row) => {
        return (_openBlock(), _createElementBlock("tr", { key: row.id }, [
          _createElementVNode("td", null, _toDisplayString(row.name), 1 /* TEXT */)
        ]))
      }), 128 /* KEYED_FRAGMENT */)),
      _createElementVNode("td", null, _toDisplayString(_ctx.total), 1 /* TEXT */)
    ]),
    _createElementVNode("table", null, [
      _createElementVNode("thead", null, [
        _createElementVNode("tr", null, [
          _createElementVNode("th", null, "Note")
        ])
      ]),
      _createElementVNode("tbody", null, [
        _createElementVNode("tr", null, [
          _createElementVNode("td", null, _toDisplayString(_ctx.note), 1 /* TEXT */)
        ])
      ])
    ])
  ], 64 /* STABLE_FRAGMENT */))
}
